01 / 09

Project Overview

BRONZA is a tanning products brand built around the idea of natural glow and sun-inspired beauty.

The brand identity was developed to create a distinctive visual presence that reflects the tanning experience through a combination of tropical inspiration, warm colors, and feminine aesthetics.

The project focuses on building a cohesive visual identity that connects the brand's personality with its products and communication across different touchpoints.

Industry Tanning Products
Market Direction Arab Market
Brand Positioning Mid-range
Deliverables Logo, Guidelines, Packaging & Social
02 / 09

Challenge & Objectives

Creating a distinctive and versatile identity that communicates the tanning category while staying consistent across every application.

The visual system needed to balance natural beauty, summer energy, and feminine appeal while ensuring clarity, recognition, and adaptability across product packaging and digital platforms.

Natural Beauty

Expressing an authentic, sun-kissed glow rather than an artificial look.

Summer Energy

Capturing warmth, light, and the vibrant spirit of coastal summer days.

Feminine Appeal

A refined, attractive personality that inspires confidence in every touchpoint.

03 / 09

Creative Concept & Brand Personality

Inspired by Nature. Defined by the Sun. BRONZA brings together natural tanning, tropical lifestyle, and feminine beauty.

Youthful & Energetic · Natural & Relaxed · Feminine & Attractive · Sunny & Vibrant
Natural tanning, tropical lifestyle, and feminine beauty come together into one warm, radiant visual direction.

The visual direction explores natural beach imagery and sun-inspired symbolism to establish a connection with the brand's product category. The design process began with hand-drawn sketches, followed by digital development and refinement.

04 / 09

Logo Concept, Development & System

A Symbol of Tropical Beauty — a flexible set of variations designed for different visual contexts, from packaging to digital platforms.

Design objectives: communicate the tanning product category, maintain clarity across different sizes, ensure adaptability across packaging and brand applications, and establish a recognizable visual identity.

Visual Identity System

Building a Consistent Visual Language — colors, typography, graphic elements, and supporting patterns that extend beyond the logo.

Color Palette

The palette combines warm orange, golden yellow, soft beige, and deep brown tones — connecting the brand with sunlight, tanning, warmth, and bronze-inspired aesthetics, while maintaining a refined look suitable for a mid-range brand.

Social Media Campaign

09 / 09

Project Outcome & Brand Guidelines

One Identity. Multiple Touchpoints. The BRONZA identity brings the logo, color palette, typography, graphic elements, packaging, and digital applications into one cohesive visual direction.

From product presentation to social media communication, the visual system demonstrates how a consistent identity can create a recognizable and unified brand experience.

Logo Variations & Usage

Primary, secondary, and icon versions with correct application rules.

Color Palette

Warm orange, golden yellow, soft beige, and deep brown codes.

Typography System

Clear, modern, and elegant typefaces for every medium.

Graphic Elements

Tropical and coastal references translated into supporting graphics.

Patterns & Supporting Assets

Decorative systems that extend the brand beyond the logo.

Construction & Clear Space

Geometric build rules and spacing that protect the mark.
